name.en-US: Sermons on the Blessed Virgin Mary
name.pt-BR: Sermões sobre a bem-aventurada Virgem Maria

description.la: Sermones de festis beatae Virginis Mariae: Purificatione, Annuntiatione, Assumtione, Nativitate. Textus ex editione Quaracchi (Opera omnia IX, 1901), ex scanno OCR, sine notis criticis.
description.en-US: Bonaventure’s sermons for the feasts of the Blessed Virgin: the Purification, Annunciation, Assumption and Nativity. The Latin is the Quaracchi edition (Opera omnia IX, 1901) from an OCR scan, without the editors’ critical notes.
description.pt-BR: Sermões sobre a bem-aventurada Virgem Maria.

sources.edition: S. Bonaventurae Opera omnia, tom. IX (Ad Claras Aquas, Quaracchi: Collegium S. Bonaventurae, 1901), pp. 633-721.
sources.description: Archive.org OCR (djvu.xml word coordinates) of the folio edition. Each page is read in two columns; marginal notes, running heads, the editors’ footnotes (variant readings, cross-references) and small-type notes are removed by layout (line pitch and measure); line-end hyphens are joined; recognisable OCR slips are corrected by a lexicon pass, so some remain. Sermon numbers within each feast follow the edition; where the OCR lost a sermon head the number is inferred.
sources.tierEvidence: Bonaventure died in 1274; the Quaracchi edition of 1901 is public domain.
